correctness.rationale: The telescoping weights give the exact iterate formula. After taking p-th powers, subadditivity reduces the orbit norm to \(B+k^\beta H_\beta b(k)\). The one-sided tail operator estimate is proved self-contained: a head/tail split at length comparable to \((B/t)^{1/\beta}\), Tonelli and Markov give weak exponent \(1/\beta\). Uniformizing \(k<N\) then gives the claimed finite-block distribution with exponent \(q_0=p/\beta\). Arnold's basis-vector computation gives harmonic divergence at the strong endpoint, and the terminal orbit value of \(e_j\) forces failure for every larger weak exponent.

value.rationale: This resolves the natural endpoint left by an explicitly sharp self-improvement theorem and distinguishes proper weak control from total endpoint failure for the extremal family. The result gives a complete strong/weak phase diagram for a canonical sharp example rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.

final_claim: For Arnold's explicit extremal positive weighted backward shift on \(\ell^p\), the critical strong self-improvement exponent \(q_0=pK/(K-1)\) is an exact weak endpoint: the finite-orbit distribution obeys a uniform weak-\(L^{q_0}\) bound, strong \(q_0\)-absolute Cesaro boundedness fails, and weak \(q\)-absolute Cesaro boundedness fails for every \(q>q_0\).
